identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase Ⅰ/Ⅱa Study of HMPL-A251 in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic HER2-expressing Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase Ⅰ/Ⅱa Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Immunogenicity and Preliminary Efficacy of HMPL-A251 in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic HER2-Expressing Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a first-in-human (FIH), phase Ⅰ/Ⅱa, open-label, multicenter clinical study of HMPL-A251 monotherapy in adult participants with unresectable, advanced or metastatic HER2-expressing solid tumors.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
* To evaluate the safety and tolerability and to determine the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and/or recommended dose(s) for expansion (RDE) of HMPL-A251 in participants with previously treated HER2+ solid tumors
* To characterize the safety and preliminary efficacy of HMPL-A251 at RDEs to determine recommended dose(s) for phase 2 (RP2D) or phase 3 (RP3D) in participants with selected HER2-expressing solid tumors

interventions.name: HMPL-A251
interventions.description: Six dose cohorts are planned for the Dose Escalation phase; at least three participants with solid tumors will be enrolled in each dose cohort. Bayesian optimal interval design with backfill (BF-BOIN, Zhao, 2023) will be used to guide dose escalation and determine the MTD and/or RDE of HMPL-A251. All study participants will receive HMPL-A251 as IV infusion until PD, intolerable toxicity, or other protocol-specified criteria for ending study treatment, whichever occurs first.

interventions.name: HMPL-A251
interventions.description: Participants will be randomized in a 1:1 ratio to receive treatment in two RDEs levels (approximately 15 participants per dose level) for each cohort. All study participants will receive HMPL-A251 as IV infusion until PD, intolerable toxicity, or other protocol-specified criteria for ending study treatment, whichever occurs first.

primaryOutcomes.description: At least three participants will be enrolled in each dose cohort. Bayesian optimal interval design with backfill (BF-BOIN) will be used to guide dose escalation and to determine the MTD of HMPL-A251

The RDE will be selected by evaluating all available data from the following criteria under consideration: Determination of MTD achieved during the dose escalation part; Safety data obtained across all different doses tested; Tolerability data, such as chronic toxicities, discontinuations, or withdrawals for toxicity that occur beyond the DLT period; PK data collected at the time of evaluation; Preliminary efficacy data.
All TEAEs will be graded according to NCI CTCAE v6.0 and coded using the Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA).

ORR is defined as the proportion of participants with Best objective response (BOR) of confirmed complete response (CR) or partial response (PR), as per investigator's assessment according to RECIST v1.1.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At least 6 weeks post dose of first participant up to approximately 24 months

primaryOutcomes.measure: Recommended doses for phase II or III studies (RP2D or RP3D) of HMPL-A251
primaryOutcomes.description: The RP2D or RP3D will be selected by evaluating all available data from the following criteria under consideration: Determination of MTD achieved during the dose escalation part; Safety data obtained across all different doses tested; Tolerability data; PK data; efficacy data.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of participants with BOR of confirmed CR, confirmed PR, or stable disease (SD) lasting at least 5 weeks.

Only applies to participants whose BOR is confirmed CR or PR and is defined as the time from the first occurrence of objective tumor response (CR or PR) to the date of first radiographic PD or death due to any cause.
